changelog: Standardize frontmatter (add read_when, slug, displayName, tags array), add Hard Rules and Failure Handling sections required by skill-design-guide, add trigger keywords to description
summary: Wrap multi-step agent workflows with pre-execution checks, side-effect queues, result validation, retry budgets, checkpointing, audit logs, and failure-rule accumulation. Prevents false successes, duplicate sends, unrecoverable crashes, and silent drift in LLM production systems. Trigger keywords: workflow safety, agent guard, pre-execution check, retry budget, idempotency, false success, audit log, drift detection, 工作流守护, 副作用队列, 漂移检测.
